data.display_address: Peninsula One, Peninsula, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Peninsula One by Select Group offers luxurious waterfront living along the Dubai Canal in the heart of Business Bay. The development combines modern design, panoramic canal and city views, and resort-style lifestyle amenities, making it perfect for urban living or investment.

Features & Amenities:

Panoramic water and city views
Swimming pool and kids’ pool for leisure
Fully equipped gym and wellness facilities
BBQ deck and landscaped outdoor spaces
Children’s play area and community zones
24/7 security, concierge services, and CCTV
Covered parking and electric car charging stations
Direct access to the Dubai Canal promenade and prime Business Bay locations
